tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rig 'dzin srog sgrub kyi rtsa gtor dang bka' srung gi mchod gtor rgyas bsdus kyi tho bzhugs so// 1$0000300rig 'dzin rtsa ba'i gtor ma ri rab bang rim bzhi steng dpal gtor gshog can pad 'dab bzhi phyogs mdog zur bzhir dpal gtor chung ba re/ bang rim gnyis par yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug gi gtor ma dpal gtor bcu drug /gsum pa la mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi gtor ma zur bzhir dpal gtor re/ phyogs bzhir g.yas skor du zhi rgyas dbang drag gi gtor ma re/ 'og ma la mdun du zlum po/ g.yas su gru bzhi/ rgyab tu zla gam/ g.yon du zur gsum rnams drug drug re/ thams cad kyi bar du mtheb kyu ril bu rtsi dmar/ rgyan me tog dang gri thod kyis mtshan pa ci mdzes/ tshe sgrub la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bzhi bzhi brtsegs steng 'dab bzhi/ de steng tshe bum gyi khar gser gyi rdo rje nyi zlas mtshan pa/ lcang lo'i 'khor 'khyud kyi rgyan gang legs mdzad/ bka' srung drag po sde bzhi'i gtor ma la/ klu bdud mun pa nag po'i gtor ma chos 'byung bsnol ma'i steng du gtor ma zur gsum smad sbrul sngo dmar gyis dkris shing bar sdig pa nag po/ rtse mor bya khyung*/ 'khor rgyas pa dpal mgon bdun cu tshang ba/ bsdu na/ srid pa'i klu chen brgyad la zur gsum sbrul

dkris pa brgyad gyis bskor ba yin/ rjes su gza' bshos brgyad kyis bskor ba'ang 'dug /srin po lang ka mgrin bcu'i gtor ma srin mkhar gser g.yu spel ba'i rgya phib yin zur la mi mgo skam rlon gang rung gis brgyan pa/ gtso bo dpal gtor zur gsum yum la mdun du dpal gtor chung ba/ rjes su pad+ma res brgyan gin 'dug /'khor sha za las byed ging bshan 'bum phrag la pho rigs gnyis rigs bzhir phye ba'i zur gsum brgyad kyis bskor ba bsdus pa'o// ma mo'i gtor ma chos 'byung bsnol ma'i steng du zur gsum rtse mor phag zhal can zhing dbyug rgyu zhags kyis mtshan pa/ 'khor ma mo 'bum phrag gi sde rnams la gtor tshogs gang rgyas dang*/ bsdu na/ rigs bzhir bsdus pa'i zur gsum bzhi/ bshan pa spu gri dmar po'i gtor ma mkhar gser gyi rgya phib yin thabs kyi steng na ra mgos mtshan pa/ 'khor skyes bu sum brgya drug cu zhes gsungs kyang*/ bsdus pa'i skabs sde brgyad kyi gtor mas bskor ba gnang gi 'dug /'phral gtor la zur gsum bzhi mtheb kyu re yin/ thang lha'i mchod gtor mkhar thabs sum brtsegs rtser nor bu dbang gis mtshan pa/ mdun du zlum po gsum dang g.yas g.yon du re re rtsi dkar yin/ 'phral gtor zlum po lnga mtheb kyu ril bu bzhi/ dpal lha'i mchod gtor dkar zlum mtheb kyu bcu gcig rgyan ldan/ mdzod lnga la rtse zlum po rtsa ba gru bzhi byas pa gsum mtheb kyu ril bu re rtsi dmar/ g.yang gtor ri rab bang rim bzhi steng dga' ba 'khyil ba ne'u le gsum/ kha nas nor bu skyug pa/ de steng nor bu mig gsum rdo rje nyi zlas mtshan pa/ g.yas g.yon du rgyal mtshan re/ mar zlum po/ thud gru bzhi/ zan zla gam/ sha zur gsum gcig tu brgyus pa re re/ rtsa ba ril bus bskor/ logs gsum la nor bu cha bdun dang*/ nor bu'i rigs gang 'thad mdzad/
